links.outcome: Self-management, quality of life, and satisfaction versus conventional follow-up at 3 months
links.effect: AI-assisted group scored higher: self-management 168.83 vs 150.11, QoL 66.34 vs 59.81, satisfaction 52.35 vs 48.75 (all P < 0.001).
links.quote: At 3 months, the AI-assisted group had higher self-management ability scores (168.83 ± 7.03 vs. 150.11 ± 7.39), QoL scores (66.34 ± 4.30 vs. 59.81 ± 4.46), and satisfaction scores (52.35 ± 2.44 vs. 48.75 ± 2.48) than the conventional care group (all P < 0.001).

unlisted_practices: Nurse-supervised AI-assisted follow-up with rule-based risk monitoring combined with LLM-assisted communication
Operationalized humanistic care within a closed-loop oncology nursing workflow

screen.reason: The study prospectively evaluates a real-world deployment of an AI-assisted follow-up system (using DeepSeek LLM and rule-based risk monitoring) compared to conventional care, but does not compare outcomes with versus without a specific safeguard or deployment practice.
